why_relevant: The second national credit-union association alongside ВАКС; together they enumerate the credit-union population. Needed for completeness because the two associations' rosters only partly overlap.

Self-described 'platform for protecting professional interests of financial-services market participants' (registered 2016, EDRPOU 40964265). Another membership pointer for the non-bank/payments segment; the Facebook page is currently the most reliably reachable presence — the afi.org.ua website was referenced but not confirmed.

source_name: Diia Business — довідник підприємця: картки галузевих асоціацій (ЄМА, УАФІК та ін.)
why_relevant: State-run business handbook with structured profile cards for sector associations (ЄМА, фінтех-асоціація and others), each pointing to the association's official site and describing its remit. A government-curated index of which associations exist — a clean way to discover associations this cell has not yet enumerated.

For every association in this cell there is a state-registry card giving EDRPOU, registration date, legal address, officers and — critically — founders/participants. For ВАФК and ВАКС the registry card actually names member/founder legal entities, providing a verifiable cross-check when an association's own member page is gated or stale.

source_name: Fintech Insider (fintechinsider.com.ua) — трейд-медіа, що ретранслює дослідження УАФІК
why_relevant: Sector trade media that summarises association research (e.g. the UAFIC fintech study) and member announcements in accessible HTML — an effective fallback when the association's own JS-rendered site or gated PDF cannot be collected, and a discovery channel for new members/actors.

source_name: НБУ — Пошук учасників платіжних систем (regulator cross-check for association rosters)
why_relevant: Not an association, but the authoritative denominator against which association membership must be diffed: the NBU register of payment systems and their participants (press coverage cites ~55 payment-market participants). Association rosters minus this register reveals both under-covered actors and non-licensed players.

source_name: Minfin.com.ua — Рейтинг банків / Рейтинг стійкості банків
source_subtype: financial media ranking / bank league table
why_relevant: Quarterly Ukrainian bank stability/profitability ranking rebuilt from NBU statutory reporting; covers banks with retail deposit portfolios above UAH 1bn and publishes an explicit methodology page, making it a structured, repeatable digest of disclosure data.

Narrative write-ups summarising full-year and quarterly banking sector outcomes ('лідери прибутків та аутсайдери'), i.e. profit leaders/losers digests of NBU data useful for spotting which results the market treats as material.

Publishes recurring bank league tables — an annual 'найефективніші банки' integrated efficiency/profitability/liquidity ranking and a full market census of ~59 licensed banks — which doubles as an actor map of the Ukrainian banking market.
Highest-velocity Ukrainian business outlet for banking-results coverage: quarterly and nine-month profit rankings, income growth comparisons, and bank-tax policy stories that frame reported earnings.

News agency that translates NBU/bank disclosure into structured English earnings items with bank-by-bank net-profit figures and YoY deltas — the cleanest English-language machine-readable narrative of Ukrainian bank quarterly results.

Banks and PSPs distribute their own results releases here verbatim (e.g. PrivatBank H1 2026 results release), so it functions as a de-facto investor-relations wire for issuers with no standalone IR page.
Ukrainian-language edition of the same wire; carries items that are not always translated into English, and is the version most often syndicated by other Ukrainian outlets.

Annual and quarterly 'bank viability' rating with a published methodology built only on publicly disclosed data, covering banks above 0.2% market share; strong for tracking financial-stability perception rather than headline profit alone.
Running banking and finance news desk that digests NBU statistics and bank disclosures, plus deposit/lending dynamics used to contextualise earnings.

Mainstream business desk covering bank pre-tax profit updates, lending records and NBU payment-institution licensing — one of the outlets that surfaces payment-market (PSP/NovaPay/Ukrposhta) stories alongside bank earnings.

Specialist Ukrainian financial-sector outlet with an infographics desk and recurring 'most profitable / most loss-making banks' items sourced from NBU releases; narrower but deeper on banking than general business media.

The main Ukrainian trade title for payments/fintech/e-commerce: covers PSP volumes, acquiring, payment-system licensing and fintech company results — the payments-side counterpart to bank profit league tables, which general business media under-cover.

Large general-news finance desk that reports NBU decisions (e.g. designation of important payment systems: Visa, Mastercard, PrivatMoney, NovaPay, Фінансовий світ) and bank results; useful for regulatory-adjacent payment-market signals.
Long-running Ukrainian business outlet (Ekonomika+ holding) covering company and bank financial results; complements EP/Forbes for corporate-level earnings write-ups.

High-volume news agency that republishes NBU-derived 'most profitable banks' rankings and top-10 profit tables quickly after data release; useful as a redundancy/timing signal for when disclosure data hits the market.

Structured, machine-readable-ish aggregation of bank profit/loss built from official registers and NBU reporting; the media rankings above frequently trace back here, so it is the pointer that shortens the path from media story to underlying data (and Opendatabot exposes a commercial API).

Consumer-finance portal and community with bank news, rates and a large forum; the forum is a weak-signal channel for service outages, PSP behaviour and customer-side changes that precede formal disclosure.
Bank product/comparison portal with per-bank financial indicator pages; useful as a secondary cross-check on media-published bank metrics and for tariff/product change tracking.

source_name: UKR.NET source aggregator — media outlet feeds (e.g. PaySpaceMagazine)
why_relevant: National news aggregator that maintains per-outlet chronological feeds; a cheap discovery layer for finding additional Ukrainian financial outlets and for backfilling an outlet's article history without crawling the outlet itself.

Insurance/finance trade portal republishing a bank reliability ranking; low independent value but a useful triangulation point and an entry into insurance-sector coverage that touches bancassurance and payments.

source_name: YouControl — analytical dossier system on Ukrainian legal entities (аналітична система YouControl)
why_relevant: Aggregates 200+ open-data sources into per-company dossiers for every registered Ukrainian bank and payment company (USREOU/ЄДРПОУ keyed), including registration data, ownership/UBO, licences, court cases, sanctions lists and financial indicators. Acts both as an enumerator of the full actor universe (by KVED 64.19 / 64.9 / 66.19) and as a persistent archive of filings after issuer sites go offline in wartime.
